items.text: The Polish Constitutional Tribunal crisis escalates with the suspension of tribunal head Bogdan Święczkowski and deputy head Bartłomiej Sochański by judge Anna Korwin-Piotrowska.
Digital currency worth US$6.3 billion is stolen from cryptocurrency exchange Binance.
In baseball, the Milwaukee Brewers defeat the Tampa Bay Rays to win the World Series.
